notes: Discovery is open: any agent can list/see others.
Interaction (agent/invoke, agent/request with a tool) requires a valid grant when the target agent registered without auto_approve.
Grants are HMAC-signed, scoped (tool / zone:<name> / *), and expire (TTL, default 1800s).
Cross-machine works via LAN UDP broadcast and/or VPN unicast seed (--peer) + gossip.
The server proxies invocations to the agent's own MCP endpoint; agents without a live endpoint are discoverable/authorizable but not executable.

Handler-level failures are returned as a normal JSON-RPC result object containing an 'error' string field (application error), not as a JSON-RPC 'error' envelope. Protocol-level failures (parse error -32700, unknown method -32601) use the JSON-RPC 'error' envelope.
Default zones created at startup: General, AI-Research, DevOps, Data-Science. Most agent/zone methods default 'zone' to 'General' when omitted.

flows.name: activate_agent
flows.description: Bring an agent online: handshake with the server, then join a zone declaring its tools/interests. If auto_approve is omitted/false, interactions with this agent will require an explicit access grant.

flows.name: discover_and_authorize
flows.description: Find agents across the whole network, locate one that offers a tool, request authorization, have the owner approve it (yielding a grant token), then invoke the tool with that grant.

flows.name: cross_network_vpn
flows.description: For cross-subnet / VPN federation where UDP broadcast does not cross the link, start the server with one or more seed peers: `python3 ga2a_server.py --port 9420 --peer <host:port>`. On startup the server sends a 'network/hello' to each seed with its own identity; the seed replies with its identity plus every peer it already knows (gossip), so the whole mesh is learned transitively. The server re-contacts seeds periodically to keep the mesh alive. Once peers are known, remote agents appear in network/agents and can be invoked via proxy just like LAN-discovered ones.

initialize.summary: Handshake; returns server info, capabilities, and available zones.

capabilities.description: Feature flags: zones, matchmaking, contextSharing, lanDiscovery, remoteProxy (all booleans).

zones.description: Names of zones currently known to this instance.

zones/list.summary: List all zones (local + aggregated from remote peers) with agent counts.

zones.description: Map of zone_name -> {agent_count, agents[], source (local|remote|mixed), remote_agents[]? (each {agent, instance})}.

zones/create.summary: Create a new zone by name.

name.description: Name of the zone to create.

error.description: Present when name is missing or the zone already exists.

agent/join.summary: Join a zone declaring capabilities (tools/resources), interests, endpoint, and consent policy. Aliased by zones/join and agent/register.

zone.description: Zone to join; created if it does not exist.

resources.description: Resources offered. Each: {uri (required), name?, description?, mime_type?}.

interests.description: What the agent seeks; used for matchmaking.

endpoint.description: The agent's own MCP endpoint used by the server to proxy tools/call. Without it the agent is discoverable but not invocable.

auto_approve.description: Consent policy. true = approve everything automatically (no grant prompt). A list of policy dicts (each may specify from_agent, zone, interest, tool) adds auto-approval rules. Absent/false = interactions stay pending until manual approval.

peers.description: Other agents already in the zone.

matches.description: Local matches for the declared interests (each {agent, role, score, matching_tools[], endpoint, source}).

agent/leave.summary: Remove an agent from a zone and drop its grant manager.

agent/match.summary: Matchmaking: find local and remote agents whose capabilities satisfy the caller's interests.

zone.description: Zone to search for local matches.

agent_name.description: The requesting agent (excluded from results); also used to look up stored interests if 'interests' is omitted.

interests.description: Interests to match. If omitted, falls back to the interests declared at join time.

matches.description: Local matches: {agent, role, score, matching_tools[], endpoint, source}.

remote_matches.description: Remote matches: {agent, role, score, matching_tools[], peer_endpoint, peer_instance, zone, source}.

note.description: Present when no interests are available to match on.

agent/discover.summary: List capabilities of agents in a zone (local, plus remote unless filtered out), optionally filtered by tool.

tool.description: If set, only agents offering this tool are returned.

include_remote.description: Include remote agents from discovered peers.

capabilities.description: Local agents: {agent, role, endpoint, tools[{name, description, input_schema}], interests[], source=local}.

remote_capabilities.description: Remote agents: {agent, role, endpoint, tools[], interests[], source=remote, peer_instance, peer_host}.

error.description: Present when the zone is not found.

agent/request.summary: Request context from another agent (local or remote). With a live endpoint + tool it proxies a tools/call; otherwise returns the target's capability declaration.

target.description: Target agent name (local zone or remote).

tool.description: Tool to invoke on the target's endpoint. If omitted (or the target has no endpoint), the target's capability declaration is returned instead.

arguments.description: Arguments passed to the target tool.

from.description: The target agent that supplied the context.

context.description: Tool result, capability declaration, or an {error, fallback} object if the endpoint/proxy was unreachable.

error.description: Present when the target agent is not found.

agent/context.summary: Summarize all context available to an agent in a zone: peers and their tools (ranked by match), plus recent context-exchange history.

agent_name.description: The agent whose view is requested; also used to look up its interests.

available_context.description: Other agents ranked by match: {agent, role, tools[], match_score}.

context_history.description: Up to the last 10 context exchanges involving this agent.

error.description: Present when the zone is not found.

agent/invoke.summary: Invoke a tool on another agent via proxy. Local targets with a grant manager require a valid grant; remote targets are forwarded to the owning instance.

target_agent.description: Target agent name. Also accepted as 'target'.

target.description: Alias for target_agent (used if target_agent is absent).

tool.description: Tool name to invoke on the target's endpoint.

grant.description: Serialized grant token. Required when the target registered a consent policy (i.e. did not auto_approve everything).

result.description: The target tool's result (present when status=ok).

hint.description: For error="authorization_required": suggests calling access/request first.

agent/message.summary: Send a lightweight message between agents (logged and acknowledged, not routed to an endpoint).

access/request.summary: Request authorization to interact with an agent. Auto-approved by policy returns a grant token immediately; otherwise the request is queued pending. Remote targets are proxied to the owning instance.

from_agent.description: Requesting agent name. Also accepted as 'from'.

target.description: Target agent name. Also accepted as 'target_agent'.

tool.description: Specific tool being requested; determines the default grant scope on approval.

grant.description: Serialized grant token, present only when status is "approved".

source.description: "remote" when the request was proxied to another instance.

error.description: Present when target is missing or the remote proxy failed.

access/pending.summary: List pending access requests awaiting an agent owner's decision.

agent_name.description: The owning agent whose pending requests to list.

pending.description: Pending requests, each {request_id, from_agent, to_agent, zone, interest, tool, created_at, status}.

access/approve.summary: Approve a pending request and issue a signed grant token.

agent_name.description: The owning agent approving the request.

request_id.description: Id of the pending request to approve.

scope.description: Grant scope: a tool name, "zone:<name>", or "*". Defaults to the requested tool, or "*" if none.

error.description: Present when params are missing, no manager exists, or the request is not pending.

agent_name.description: The owning agent denying the request.

request_id.description: Id of the pending request to deny.

status.description: "denied" if a pending request was found, otherwise "not_found".

error.description: Present when params are missing or no manager exists.

access/revoke.summary: Revoke a previously issued grant by id.

agent_name.description: The owning agent revoking the grant.

grant_id.description: Id of the grant to revoke.

status.description: "revoked" if the grant existed and is now revoked, otherwise "not_found".

error.description: Present when params are missing or no manager exists.

access/grants.summary: List all grants issued by an agent owner (including revoked ones).

agent_name.description: The owning agent whose grants to list.

grants.description: Grants, each {grant_id, from_agent, to_agent, zone, scope, issued_at, expires_at, signature}.

network/peers.summary: List all GA2A instances discovered on the LAN, plus this instance's own identity.

peers.description: Discovered peers: {instance, host, port, mcp_endpoint, zones[], agent_count, last_seen}.

network/agents.summary: List every agent known to this instance: local agents and remote agents from discovered peers.

local_agents.description: Local: {agent, role, zone, tools[], interests[], source=local, instance}.

remote_agents.description: Remote: {agent, role, zone, tools[], interests[], source=remote, instance, peer_endpoint, peer_host}.

network/find.summary: Search the whole network (local + remote) for a named agent and/or a tool.

tool.description: Tool name to search for across all agents.

results.description: Matches. Local: {agent, role, zone, tools[]|tool, source=local, instance, endpoint}. Remote: {agent, role, zone, tools[]|tool, source=remote, instance, peer_endpoint}.

network/hello.summary: Unicast handshake + gossip. Registers the caller's identity as a known peer and replies with this instance's identity plus every peer it knows (mesh learning). Used for VPN/cross-subnet seeding via --peer.

instance_id.description: The caller peer's unique instance name; required for the peer to be registered.

agent_details.description: Per-agent details: {agent_name: {role, tools[], interests[], zone, endpoint}}.

known_peers.description: Optional list of peer identities the caller already knows, for transitive gossip.

identity.description: This instance's identity: {instance_id, host, port, mcp_endpoint, zones[], agents{}, agent_details{}}.

known_peers.description: Identities of all peers this instance knows, each {instance_id, host, port, mcp_endpoint, zones[], agents{}, agent_details{}}.
